title: Vote: align REST OpenAPI expressions with the Iceberg expression specification
summary: Prashant Singh called a vote to adopt PR #17138, which updates the REST catalog OpenAPI specification so that its expression schemas match the expression grammar defined in the Iceberg expression specification (PR #16652). The vote was to stay open for at least 72 hours. Junwang Zhao posted a review comment about the changes to required fields; Prashant replied that the comment had been answered on the PR, and Junwang later voted +1. Ryan Blue voted +1 and said the change fixes scan planning filters and supports new features such as check constraints. All other replies were +1 votes. The thread as captured does not include a message announcing the result.

positions.stance: Adopt the OpenAPI change so REST expression schemas align with the expression specification grammar.
Raised a review comment on the PR about the changes to required fields.
Votes +1; the change fixes up scan planning filters and supports new features like check constraints.

outcome.note: No result message is in the thread. Votes cast: 14 +1, of which 3 marked binding, 9 marked non-binding and 2 unmarked; no 0 or -1.

why_it_matters: REST catalog servers and clients that exchange filter expressions, for example in scan planning, will follow the shared expression grammar.
